Subject: Request: CAIQ/SIG access-control artifacts (SSO/SCIM/RBAC)

Hi Vivek,

Thanks for the quick intro yesterday. As part of Alverton's SIG intake we need a compact set of artifacts to validate your access-control controls. Our checklist is focused on SSO/SAML flows, SCIM provisioning, and RBAC/least-privilege provisioning for service accounts. Specifically we'd like:

- A small sample of SAML assertion logs (successful and one expired/failed assertion)
- SCIM delta export showing provisioning + deprovisioning events over a 30-day window
- The RBAC role matrix (who can create service accounts, who can escalate privileges) and a short note on approval workflow for elevated roles
- Any runbook or automation notes for just-in-time admin access or emergency break-glass procedures

We can accept artifacts via a shared Drive folder or encrypted attachment. I've attached our evidence grid (alverton_SIG_evidence_grid_v1.xlsx) with the fields we need mapped to SIG/CAIQ questions.

Can you confirm feasibility and an ETA for initial delivery? We are targeting a SOC2 readiness checkpoint next week.

Appreciate it,
Sam
Sam Tully
Security Manager, Alverton Health
sam.tully@alverton.io
phone: +1 415-555-0192

Sam —

Thanks for the clear checklist and the spreadsheet. We can provide the items you listed; I want to loop in Laura (controls & compliance lead) and Marcus (runtime infra) to coordinate the artifacts and a secure delivery. High-level ETA: initial bundle by EOD Tuesday (Jun 5), full SCIM delta export and RBAC matrix by Wednesday EOD if that works for your schedule.

Couple quick clarifying points:
- For SAML assertion logs: do you need raw HTTP POST traces or formatted SAML assertion samples? We usually provide the assertion XML with redaction of PII + a short audit log mapping.
- For the SCIM delta: we can provide a CSV with event timestamps and actor IDs. Does your team require identity hashes or full email addresses? We typically hash external IDs for privacy.

If you prefer a different cadence or need the artifacts in a particular format (ZIP of XMLs, CSVs, or Drive links), say the word and we'll adapt.

I'll coordinate delivery to the Drive link you specified; we'll also include a short README explaining redactions and processing steps.

Regards,
Vivek Kulkarni

Subject: Alverton evidence bundle: SAML samples + RBAC matrix (prelim)

Hi Sam —

Per Vivek's note, attaching the preliminary bundle. Deliverables included in this package:

1) saml_assertion_samples.zip — contains three redacted SAML assertion XMLs (one success, one expired, one signature-failure). Each XML is accompanied by a one-line explanation of the failure mode.
2) scim-delta-sample-202805.csv — 30-day delta sample with columns: timestamp, scim_action, actor_id_hash, target_user_hash, source_system, note. Actor IDs are salted hashes to preserve privacy; we can provide plain emails under NDA if required.
3) RBAC_role_matrix_v1.csv (attached inside the Drive folder) — maps role -> privileges -> owning-team -> approval-path.
4) README_evidence_delivery.md — short notes about how logs were exported, query parameters, and timezones.

Attachment details: I uploaded the files to the shared Drive folder you indicated and also attached the SAML samples and SCIM CSV to this message for convenience (see attachments list).

Notes / caveats:
- SCIM export: we captured delta events from 2028-05-01 to 2028-05-31. Events are produced by our provisioning service and include create/update/delete. We do not include password hashes or MFA artifacts; authentication logs are separate (we can pull SSO login logs if you need them).
- RBAC matrix: this is the living matrix used by our Platform team; it includes service account owners and the documented approval workflow for privileged elevation. The matrix highlights two exception paths: emergency break-glass and scheduled temporary elevation (both require two approvers).

Next steps:
- Please confirm receipt and whether the salted-hash approach is acceptable for your reviewers. If you need raw identifiers, share a read-only SFTP or an NDA addendum and we'll deliver.
- Marcus — can you confirm we can provide the SCIM CSV in both UTC and local timezone formats if Alverton requests it?

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Manager, Controls & Compliance
Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.ai

Attachments: saml_assertion_samples.zip (xmls), scim-delta-sample-202805.csv (csv)

Sam / team —

Quick follow-up on the SCIM sample and delta export:
- The attached scim-delta-sample-202805.csv is a sanitized sample exported from our provisioning service (version 2.3). It contains representative create/update/delete events and includes an "actor_role" field (admin, svc_account, integrator) to help map actions to privilege levels.
- We can also provide a short script (Python) that replays the delta for local validation; if you want that, tell us where to drop it and we'll add it to the drive.
- Regarding timestamps: events are exported in UTC by default. Laura can provide a second CSV converted to the PST timezone if your reviewers prefer local time.

One operational note: service accounts created by CI/CD pipelines appear under a single "svc_account" principal; if you require individual pipeline identities we can start emitting pipeline-specific labels (small change, 2–3 business days).

If everything in the package looks good, we can mark this as the official response for the SIG/CAIQ access-control items. Otherwise, flag any missing bits and we'll prioritize.
